_comment: Default input for actor pipelinelabs/lead-scraper-apollo-zoominfo-lusha-ppe. This is the Luxvance baseline: UK Director+ Sales/BD/Marketing at 10-100 emp B2B companies. Override fields per campaign — country, employee band, persona keywords, totalResults. Do NOT change roleMatchMode, hasEmail, resetProgress, or companyIndustryExcludes without a specific reason.
_seniority_note: Apollo merges Head→director (~99% accuracy). Exclude manager (catches ICs). Valid values: c_suite, vp, director, manager, senior, entry, owner, partner, intern.
_function_note: marketing catches Growth, Demand Gen, Revenue, Marketing Ops leaders too.
_industry_excludes_note: 33 industries. B2C, regulated, low-LTV. Adjust per campaign — e.g. an Insurance campaign would remove Insurance from this list.
_total_results_note: Cap. Apify charges per result delivered. Set per campaign — typical 5,000-25,000 for a campaign-scale scrape.
_role_match_mode_note: REQUIRED. Default 'any' lets entry-level slip past the seniority filter. Always 'all'.
_reset_progress_note: Resume from prior runs. Avoids paying for duplicates when re-running the same filter.
